pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'.

path.description: Directory to search in. Required. Use '.' for the current working directory. There is no implicit default — the model must always state the search root.

workdir.description: Absolute directory on the target daemon's file system that this call runs in. Required on every call; it is never inherited from a previous call, a session default, or the environment root. Provide an expanded absolute path (no '~', no environment variable placeholders); Windows targets use a drive-rooted or UNC path.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 1000.

timeout_seconds.description: Positive timeout in seconds. No timeout is applied by default.
